newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht falls to record low of 32.63 onshore.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht falls to record low of 32.63 onshore.

text.p: The Thai baht dropped to a new new record low of 32.63 per dollar onshore early on Thursday as commercial demand for dollars continued to drive the recently-floated currency lower, dealers said.

The currency was quoted at 32.550/32.770 per dollar on both onshore and offshore markets early with the lowest deal going through at 32.63, dealers said. The baht was quoted at 32.25/32.55 late on Wednesday.

"I think there is going to be a new story for you as the spot is going higher to a new record. The same factors are driving sentiment. There appears to be only selling in the market at the moment," said a dealer at a local bank.
"Volumes are quite small as it is just corporate demand. The banks are squaring positions, there is no speculation at all," he added.
